picks.zh:
連跌 5 週，這輪下跌跟前幾輪比算深嗎？

週期頂部後第 398 天，比特幣在頂部下方 40.1%；前三輪同一天在 74.7%–81.6%。

前三輪最低跌了 76.7%–84.5%，這輪到目前最低是 −53.1%。只有三輪樣本，看不出時間表。

#比特幣 #BTC #週期
picks.en:
Five red weeks. How deep is this drawdown versus past cycles?

Day 398 after the top: BTC is 40.1% below it. Past three cycles, same day: 74.7%–81.6% below.

Their lows: −76.7% to −84.5%. This cycle so far: −53.1%. Three cycles say nothing about timing.

#Bitcoin #BTC #cycles
